articles.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
articles.snippet: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

articles.title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
articles.snippet: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.

articles.title: Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin, CEO Says—About 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows
articles.snippet: Paolo Ardoino told the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano the company owns “give or take 150,000 Bitcoin,” but its Q3 reserve report implies just 100,060.

articles.title: Justin Sun Accuses Trump-Backed World Liberty of Using UAE Ties to Escape Federal Court
articles.snippet: Tron founder Justin Sun said he has asked a federal court to sanction World Liberty Financial, alleging the Trump family-backed venture delayed disclosing UAE ties that could defeat federal jurisdiction over his lawsuit.
